major_architectural_decisions: DDD modular monolith: Contexts (Commerce, Learning, Analytics) + Domains (Catalog, Authoring, Assessment, Certification, Live, Crm) + Platform (Identity, Notifications, Media, Homepage, Branding, Navigation, Pages, Features, Seo, Shared kernel). Deptrac enforces dependency direction.
Cross-context communication only via Ports in app/Platform/Shared/<Cap>/Contracts (e.g. EntitlementPort, CourseEnrollmentPort, MediaReferencePort). Contexts never import each other's Eloquent models.
Money is always integer minor units (or the Money VO). Never floats.
Idempotency is mandatory on payments, orders, refunds, subscriptions and webhooks. Every webhook signature is verified inside the gateway adapter. No gateway SDK calls outside adapters.
Tax and invoices are server-authoritative; finalized financial records are immutable.
PHPStan level 6 with a baseline: existing models use getAttribute()-backed access (baselined property.notFound); only net-new models get @property blocks — to preserve baseline compatibility.

Frontend API envelope: ApiResponse::success -> {data}; ApiResponse::paginated -> {data, meta, links}. Paginated list endpoints MUST use ::paginated (a nested resource collection under ::success silently drops meta/links).

active_modules.commerce: Products, prices, cart, coupons/promotions, checkout, orders, invoices, credit notes, refunds, subscriptions (renew/grace/cancel/reactivate), entitlements, payments (Fake + MENA gateways: Paymob/Moyasar/HyperPay/Tap/APS/Stripe), webhooks, dunning, commerce analytics.
active_modules.learning: Enrollment, entitlement, lesson access/runtime, progress (lesson/video/block), completion policy, certificates eligibility.
active_modules.platform: Media (upload/playback/webhooks), Notifications (fan-out, dead-letter), Homepage/Branding/Navigation/Pages/SEO CMS, Feature flags.
active_modules.frontend: Next.js 15 App Router; route groups (marketing), (learning), (instructor), (commerce), (account), (organization), (crm), (analytics); AppShell (sidebar+drawer) for authenticated areas; LandingHeader for public + commerce checkout.

requires_product_decision: Login user-enumeration + email-only lockout DoS (auth, MED, not launch-critical): distinct 401/403/423 responses before the password check form an enumeration oracle, and lockout keyed on email alone enables a targeted-DoS. Security-correct fix = uniform 401 hiding account state, but that removes the 'account locked/disabled' UX and rewrites existing auth tests. Awaiting decision: harden (uniform response + decaying lockout) vs keep current UX.
known_technical_debt: No git history — all state is file-write + SHA-256 verified, no commits. A first commit + branch strategy is recommended before further waves.

Sandbox-only composer hacks (phpstan local-zip dist, preferred-install source, use-github-api=false) exist in the sandbox to build a runtime; they are NOT in the device composer.json/lock and must never be synced.
